title: Mineral production benchmark
methodology: Observed state-level beneficiated production with at least 12 years and a 2025 observation. Tonnes are not aggregated between minerals.
forecast_methodology: Three candidates are compared by rolling backtest: persistence, weighted logarithmic trend and damped Holt. A trend is used only when it improves persistence by at least 15% and its sMAPE is at most 35%. Otherwise the reference is persistence. Ranges are error-calibrated scenario bands, not confidence intervals.
